subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Three in Every Religion
description: A micro-lesson that makes Three in Every Religion usable.

hook.text: The Christian Trinity. The Hindu Trimurti. The Three Jewels of Buddhism. Three rules the sacred world.

buildup.text: Father, Son, Holy Spirit. Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva. Buddha, Dharma, Sangha. Three appears across every faith.

discovery.text: Three creates a pattern with a beginning, middle, and end. It's the minimum structure for a complete story.

twist.text: Two creates opposition. Three resolves it. The third element mediates between extremes—that's its power.

climax.text: Three is the first number that creates a shape: the triangle. Structure, stability, and story begin at three.

punchline.text: Beginning. Middle. End. Story starts there.

quiz.question: Why is three symbolically powerful across cultures?
options: It creates a complete pattern with beginning, middle, and end
